en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a street corner with a two‑storey stucco building housing a restaurant. Several men stand smiling behind a wooden fence on the raised terrace in front. The sloped cobblestone street curves to the left, lined with multi‑storey houses. Leafless tree branches frame the scene. A sign on the façade reads "Restaurant Zschopauterrasse." Another large painted word starting with "Zschop…" is visible on the side wall.
